title: [platform_tests] Test thermal_state_db.py pulls duplicated data causing test failure
author: amulyan7
body:
The test case fails because there is a mismatch in the number of thermal_sensors read from redis-dump command and output of "show platform temperature"
The reason for mismatch is linked to the key match "\*TEMP\*"
With this key match, redis-dump pulls up entries from another table (PHYSICAL_ENTITY_INFO) with sensor names containing the word TEMP in them along with entries from TEMPERATURE_INFO table, whereas it is compared against output of "show platform temperature" which pulls data only from TEMPERATURE_INFO table. Ideally redis should only fetch data from TEMPERATURE_INFO table

This can be avoided this by changing the key match to either "TEMP*" or using full table name "TEMPERATURE_INFO*"

### Description of PR

Test case test_thermal_state_db failure because of mismatch in the number of thermal sensors read from redis-dump command and output of "show platform temperature". There is duplication of sensors read from redis command due to key match "\*TEMP\*", which causes it to pull data from a different table (PHYSICAL_ENTITY_INFO)(not needed) along with TEMPERATURE_INFO (needed) table
